claims.citation: New York Herald, 4 September 1866, p. 9, col. 3
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Malta (Br), Macauley, Liverpool, Aug 21, via
Queenstown 22d, with mdse and 469 passengers, to E Cunard.
Aug 23, 11 AM, passed a National Co's steamship, bound E;
26th, steamship Etna, hence for Liverpool; 1st inst, a steam-
ship bound E, signal 6 fireballs, 1 rocket repeated.
